# Smart VAT Kenya

> Professional VAT registration services and monthly iTax filing for Kenyan SMEs. Flat-fee pricing, M-PESA accepted, WhatsApp support. Based in Nairobi, Kenya.

## What We Do

Smart VAT Kenya handles KRA VAT compliance end-to-end for small and medium-sized Kenyan businesses:

- **VAT Registration** — KES 5,000 flat fee, completed in 1–3 working days via the KRA iTax portal (itax.kra.go.ke)
- **Monthly VAT Filing** — KES 3,500/month, filed before the 20th KRA deadline (we file on the 17th)
- **KRA Penalty Waiver** — KES 4,000 per application, drafted and submitted to KRA on your behalf
- **Free Tools** — Kenya VAT Calculator, Penalty Waiver Wizard, iTax Error Diagnosis, and VAT Registration Quiz

## Key Facts About Kenya VAT (2026)

- Kenya VAT standard rate: **16%** (VAT Act, Cap. 476)
- Mandatory registration threshold: **KES 8 million** annual taxable turnover (Finance Act 2025 raised from KES 5 million)
- Voluntary registration: allowed from KES 5 million
- Non-registration penalty: **KES 100,000 per month** (or tax due whichever higher)
- Monthly filing deadline: **20th of the following month** (nil returns included)
- Late-filing penalty: **KES 10,000 fixed** + 5% of tax due + 1% monthly interest (whichever is higher)
- Late payment penalty: **5% of unpaid tax** + 1% interest per month
- eTIMS non-compliance: **KES 50,000 per month** (separate from VAT penalties)
- eTIMS system integration failure: **KES 500,000 per month**
- Zero-rated supplies (0%): exports, basic foodstuffs, medical equipment, water
- Exempt supplies: financial services, education, residential property rental
- VAT returns filed via: **KRA iTax portal** (itax.kra.go.ke)
- VAT remittance: **M-PESA Paybill 572572** (KRA PIN as account number)
- eTIMS: All businesses must onboard eTIMS and issue electronic tax invoices. From 2026, KRA validates income and expenses against eTIMS data — non-compliant invoices = denied deductions
- VAT refund window: **12 months** (reduced from 24 by Finance Act 2025)
- VAT Special Table: KRA-maintained list of flagged suppliers. Input VAT claims from Special Table suppliers are automatically rejected by iTax
